subject: Temporary rate elevation request & proposed escrowed credit path
messages:
From: Sarah Cho <sarah.cho@arcadiahealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@arcadiahealth.com
Date: Sun, 7 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Need temporary throughput increase for June 18-22 launch

Hi Monica,

We're ramping into a controlled marketing launch the week of June 18 and our internal forecasts show a sharply elevated inference volume for ~72 hours. Our engineering team ran a dry-run and we expect a 6x spike from baseline during peak hours; we need a short-term uplift in rate limits and a headroom guarantee so our product doesn't hit throttles.

Can Redwood support a provisional uplift (T+1) for a 5-day window? Procurement asked that any temporary uplift be paired with a simple reconciliation path (credits or prorated surcharge) so finance can approve it quickly. I've attached our May usage CSV and a draft PO.

Key asks:
- Guaranteed headroom for June 18-22: ability to sustain x6 peak for 72 hours
- Pricing approach for overrun vs. pre-approved credit pool
- Fast turnaround (we need billing/contract notes by EOD Tue 6/9)

Thanks — happy to jump on a short call if easier.

Best,
Sarah Cho
Director, Product Operations
Arcadia Health

Attachments: Arcadia_usage_report_May2026.csv, ARC-PO-9876.pdf

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Need temporary throughput increase for June 18-22 launch

Hi Sarah — thanks for the heads up and the files. We can support a short, predictable uplift while protecting both parties. Proposed options below (pick one and we will generate the addendum + DocuSign):

Option A — Escrowed credit (fastest)
- We provision a provisional headroom equal to 6x baseline for the requested window.
- Arcadia prepays an escrowed credit equal to 75% of expected incremental cost (est. $9k) to be applied against any overrun within the window. Unused escrow credited back to next invoice.
- If consumption exceeds escrow, overrun billed at our transient overrun rate of $0.045/token beyond escrow.

Option B — Temporary blended uplift (simpler billing)
- For the 5-day window, we elevate your rate tier to the next band; fixed blended rate applied to all tokens consumed during the window. No escrow needed.

Option C — Short-term committed top-up (discounted)
- Arcadia commits to a monthly uplift for June (pro-rated) and receives 10% discount on uplifted units; additional overrun billed at a reduced surcharge.

Operational notes:
- We will place a soft cap and proactive throttling alerts; we can route excess to a compatible model variant if desired.
- If you want DocuSign now, I can circulate a 1-page addendum that captures the chosen option + amount and a single PO reference.

Attached: proposed-addendum-ARC-3412.pdf (template) — I left the amounts blank until you confirm option. Lauren, can you confirm standard escrow mechanics and the account to route a temporary payment?

Regards,
Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Looping in a quick pricing note — Monica, your Option A looks like the easiest path to get procurement comfortable and keep revenue protected. Couple quick asks for the addendum before you send:

- Confirm estimated escrow amount in dollars (use the attached usage as baseline to compute; if Sarah agrees we'll lock $9,000 provisional)
- Define the exact overrun rate we apply once escrow is consumed (I suggest $0.045/token as you noted)
- Add an explicit reconciliation timeline (we reconcile within 10 business days post-window)

Lauren — if escrow payment is preferred, can Finance accept a credit memo flow (invoice the escrow as a prepayment sku) and hold it against ARC-3412? Also confirm who owns chargeback risk once escrow is consumed. If that is slow, Option B blended uplift is fallback.

Thanks — happy to be on a quick 20-min call if we need signoff today.

—Aditya

Sarah — thanks, this works. Confirmation and next steps below (finalized for DocuSign):

Agreed path (Option A, revised per your asks):
- Provisional headroom: 6x baseline for June 18-22 (72-hour peak window).
- Escrow: Arcadia will provision an escrowed prepayment of $9,000 to Redwood (invoiced as prepayment SKU).
- Reconciliation: Redwood will reconcile actual incremental usage vs. escrow within 10 business days after the window closes (by July 2).
- Refund: Any unused escrow is credited to Arcadia's next invoice and applied within 30 days after reconciliation.
- Overrun cap: If usage exceeds escrow, overrun will be billed at $0.06/token, not to exceed that cap. Redwood will notify Arcadia at 80% and 100% of escrow consumption; additional billing beyond escrow requires explicit notice and will be invoiced following the reconciliation cadence.

Operational items:

- Aditya and I will enable proactive alerts and a temporary routing rule to circuit-break to a lower-capacity variant if you want a graceful fallback.
